criteria.requirement: Add --encoding-errors strict|replace|ignore to real CLI conversion while preserving its existing default ignore behavior and exact ordinary file output. Route the explicit policy through main/convert/convert_file and raw-buffer stdin where available, keeping existing direct calls valid with keyword-only errors="ignore" defaults. Explicit strict decoding exits nonzero before publishing that document and reports only input source plus byte position on stderr, without echoing content. Explicit replace/ignore follow standard codec semantics; valid Unicode output is unchanged and unknown policies are rejected. Do not treat strict decoding failures as successful truncated documents.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
